Before
 Hon'Ble Smt. Justice Sunita Yadav
 On The 15 th Of July, 2024
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 29417 of 2024
 Bhoora Kushwah
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others
 Appearance:
 (By Shri Rajesh Pathak - Advocate)
 (By Smt. Abha Mishra - Public Prosecutor For Respondent
 No.1/State)
 Order

This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the CrPC for grant of bail relating to Crime No. 54 of 2024 registered at Police Station Bahadurpur, District Ashoknagar (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 363, 366-A, 376 (2) N of IPC and Section 5L/6 of POCSO Act.
Learned counsel for the applicant argued that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated.
It is further argued that allegedly the prosecutrix got missing on 19.03.2024 and was recovered on 05.04.2024.
In her statement recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C., she has clearly indicated that she wanted to marry with the applicant/accused, therefore, she left her house.
Hence, the question of abduction does not arise.
It is further argued that as per the statement of the prosecutrix, she solemnized marriage with the applicant/accused and was living with him as his wife.
There is no evidence that she was living with the applicant/accused and was visiting with him on various places by public transport.
She did not try to escape or raise alarm.
Under all these circumstances so also in the light of the fact that the applicant is under 2 MCRC-29417-2024 custody since 06.04.2024.
After completion of investigation, charge sheet has already been filed, therefore, his custodial interrogation is not required anymore.
Further argument is that applicant is resident of District - Ashoknagar (Madhya Pradesh) and there is no possibility of his absconsion and tampering with the prosecution evidence.
Hence, prayed for grant of bail to the applicant.
Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor for respondent No.1/the State has vehemently opposed the bail application and prayed for its rejection.
Heard learned counsel for the rival parties and perused the case diary available on record.

sentences.text: Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, but without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this application is allowed and it is directed that the applicant be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000 (Rupees One Lac Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court/committal court.
Learned State counsel is directed to send an e-copy of this order to the Station House Officer of the concerned Police Station for information and necessary action.
E- copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for compliance, if possible, by the office of this Court.
Certified copy as per rules.

(SUNITA YADAV) JUDGE AK/-
